GenAiPromptTemplate.description: Get All Doctors Available Time Slots for the Day

templateVersions.content:
Based on DoctorData, DoctorEventBookedData, TimeSlotData and PreviouslySeenDoctors Should give doctors available timings for the data. Time Zone is India +5.30 DoctorData Contains Name,Doctor Id and Operating hours Id DoctorEventBookedData Contains the already booked timings of the doctor for that day. This will tell which timeslots between should not be shown in the output. For example if it is between 2 pm to 3 pm then u will not show 2:00 PM , 2:30 PM Time Slot TimeSlotData Contains the doctors working Hours for that day. PreviouslySeenDoctors Contains Doctor Name and Doctor id
Note: Doctor Id, Operating Hrs Id are used as foreign keys for connecting each data.
The Data: DoctorData: {!$Input:DoctorData} DoctorEventBookedData: {!$Input:DoctorEventBookedData} TimeSlotData: {!$Input:TimeSlotData} PreviouslySeenDoctors: {!$Input:PreviouslySeenDoctors}
So based on this give output like below for all doctors.
Example:
Name: Ashok Kumar (Preferred - Previously Seen) Note: (Preferred - Previously Seen) is shown only if the PreviouslySeenDoctors data matches with Doctor Data and if that doctor is already Seen. Available Time Slots: 8:00 AM,8:30 AM,9:00 AM,9:30 AM,12:00 PM,1:00 PM Note: the input data might be in 24hrs time so calculate based on that and show as per example. Show all doctors then tell
Type Doctor Name and Time Slot to schedule appointment.
